labs.name: Backwards dash-jump: turn away from a wall and dash-jump on one tick
Boosted double jump: a hyper over a spiked pillar that only the boosted double jump clears by tick 20
Checkpoint mid air jump: a ground jump from a respawn 64 u above the floor
Checkpoint mid air super: a super from a respawn's held onGround
Checkpoint mid air walljump: a wall cling's wall coyote carried through a quick restart
Corner jump: standing on the platform's end with the body over a flush spike pit, then a standing jump
Coyote jump: any coyote tick, then the last one
Ground bounce: a down dash into the floor and a jump in it
Dash mid air coyote jump: a full ground jump after a dash off the ledge
Dash momentum storage: a ground dash holds the momentum through friction and gives 95% back at its end
Dash-through buy: bonk the first shop box, dash along the row: three buy triggers in one dash (real Course 1 shop)
Edge spike jump next to a wall: out from under a low ceiling, off the spike strip at the wall's foot, up the wall
Edge spike jump: the last jump inside a spike strip's grace
Edge stop: a turn into a hanging wall's bottom edge takes all the rise
Superbounce double jump: a double jump right after the superbounce keeps half its speed
Fast steps blocks clip: a step-up teleports the dot up through a slab
Fast steps blocks: run up a 45-degree stair of 32x32 blocks on step-ups
Fast steps slopes glitch: step-ups into a low ceiling, kept alive by jump spam
Fast steps slopes: run up the game's slope tiles on step-ups
Final-cling float: last cling on moss, refill on metal, float up the chimney
Float Ultra: the second hyper after FloatingOrigin moves the world
Freeze aim: dash from a ledge onto a spiked pillar that only the freeze aim lands on
Gap stick: turning every tick in a 45-wide shaft holds the dot up
Ground bounce momentum pump: chained ground bounces grow the hyper's momentum
Up super: a super from an up dash's coyote frames
Hyper stored superbounce: a hyper, then the carried wall coyote as a dash boost
Inslope wallbounce: a superbounce off a slope's face
Inwall super into wall: clip, super into the wall, turn back, clip again
Inwall super: a wall clip's in-wall ground, then a super off it in mid air
Inwall wallbounce: turned dashes from a cling step the dot up the wall
Jump-through buy: one hop from under the Wall jump box into the Clone box's buy trigger (real Course 1 shop)
KB wall clip: a full-tilt tap toward the wall at the jump's apex
Landing jump keeps downward momentum: a jump buffered for the landing tick keeps momentum.y
Landing tick jump: a jump on the landing tick keeps the momentum ground friction takes a tick later
Late gate touch: brush Course 1's start gate from the far side
Momentum after quick restart: a wall jump's lock runs on at the checkpoint
Overhang slide: a sideways spring into a 45° overhang turns the launch into a slide down
Pauselift from a wall cling up a tall wall
Reverse super on a switching block: the floor swaps away under the dash, coyote keeps the super
Reverse super: dash right, flip the stick left in the freeze and jump
Reverse walljump: cross a shaft facing back, then wall jump into the far wall
Roof squeeze: jump spam carries the short hitbox through a 70-tall tunnel
Slope sliding: a near-vertical slope is ground: slide down it and jump off it
Spike fall: walking across a flush spike patch the ground rays can't stand on
Spike grace: the one spike jump in a shaft
Spike super: a super off the spike strip's edge, inside its grace
Spike wallbounce: a superbounce out of a window in a spiked wall face
Spring clip: a downward spring's momentum falls through a spike strip a plain fall dies in
Spring dash stack, sideways: a flat spring dash carries the first spring's momentum into a second one
Spring dash stack, upward: an up-right dash carries the first spring's momentum into a second up spring
Spring dash stack: a straight-down dash through a second down spring keeps both momenta
Spring dash: a dash cancels a sideways spring's lock and holds the dot under a spike ceiling
Spring double hit, sideways: a wall holds the dot in the spring's trigger until its cooldown ends
Spring double hit: a double jump in the spring's trigger takes a second hit
Stored superbounce: a super, then the carried wall coyote as a dash boost
Stored wall jump: cling, land, carry the wall coyote to open floor
Super ground bounce: a ground bounce that keeps the super's momentum
Super in switching blocks: the swap puts an orange block on the dot, the super leaves it inside the squish grace
Super in switching spikes: the swap turns orange spikes on around the dot, the super leaves them inside their grace
Super: a jump in a ground dash
Superbounce double jump up a spiked wall: superbounces off the spikes themselves, a double jump after each
Superbounce off a plain wall
Two-button jump: J1 + J2 double jumps on the first tick it can at full height; one button must release first
Ultra: a hyper 4 u or more below the last one gets the pre-dash momentum back
Chained hyper (ultra): a second hyper 50 u lower adds the pre-dash momentum
Up-diagonal turned dash climb: turned dashes from a cling slide up the wall and get the dash back
GC wall clip: two light-flick clips up a wall onto its top
Wall coyote jump: slide off the wall's bottom, jump through a low window
Wall dash: a diagonal dash from a cling keeps x at 1
Wallbounce: an up-diagonal dash into a wall and a buffered jump
Hyper ground bounce: a hyper, then a down dash and a jump in it
Hyper (wavedash): a down-diagonal dash that lands, and a jump in it
Zip mover intangibility: after a jump off a zip mover it isn't a wall for 8 ticks
